title: First-boot slot recovery can anchor noninitial replay state at floor one
description: Security review of so3l/0919 integration: before manifest SLOT commit, if gateway-slot-replay.bin exists without its external floor, lichend writes floor=1 and loads any valid store. A noninitial generation>1 store is therefore accepted against floor1; after a failed attempt both files remain and are also accepted on retry. Legitimate first-boot partial can only be generation 1 with no claims. After loading any stage<SLOT recovery, require slot_replay_generation()==1 (and empty verifier state if exposed) before committing the manifest; reject higher generations and test retry with both files present.
close_reason: Fixed: recover_or_provision_slot_replay gates on initial_resume_state_is_valid (stage<SLOT reduces to generation==1) BEFORE save_provision_manifest; retry-with-both-files test proves rejection on both attempts with manifest never committed. Forged sealed stores rejected by Schnorr48 seal + local_iid binding. Review follow-ups filed (pre-gate floor write, emptiness check).
